purpose: Project-level development surfaces used by composable AIDOS profiles and per-Definition applicability classification.

surfaces.label: UI structure
surfaces.description: Screens, pages, layouts, navigation, dialogs, forms and visible component structure.

surfaces.label: UX and interaction behaviour
surfaces.description: Interaction patterns, state transitions, feedback, validation, loading, empty and error behaviour.

surfaces.label: Visual design
surfaces.description: Typography, spacing, colour, theming, hierarchy, branding and reusable visual patterns.

surfaces.label: Responsive behaviour
surfaces.description: Material viewport, orientation and adaptive layout behaviour.

surfaces.label: UI accessibility
surfaces.description: Keyboard/focus, semantics, labels and other relevant accessibility behaviour for user-facing UI.

surfaces.label: Content and information architecture
surfaces.description: Content structure, labels, navigation taxonomy and information hierarchy.

surfaces.label: Localization and multilingual behaviour
surfaces.description: Languages, locale selection, translation coverage and locale-dependent product behaviour.

surfaces.label: SEO and discoverability
surfaces.description: Search-engine-facing metadata, crawlability, indexing and public discoverability where relevant.

surfaces.label: API and interface contracts
surfaces.description: HTTP/RPC/public/internal API contracts, schemas, versioning and error contracts.

surfaces.label: Tool and agent contracts
surfaces.description: Machine-invokable tool contracts such as MCP or hosted agent/app tools, including inputs, outputs and side-effect declarations.

surfaces.label: Conversation interaction
surfaces.description: Conversation-driven behaviour, tool/result presentation and conversational state or orchestration.

surfaces.label: Authentication
surfaces.description: Identity establishment, login, credentials, tokens and session lifecycle.

surfaces.label: Authorization
surfaces.description: Roles, permissions, policy checks and resource/action authority.

surfaces.label: Data, persistence and lifecycle
surfaces.description: Persistent data, schemas, mutation, migration, retention and deletion.

surfaces.label: Background processing
surfaces.description: Jobs, queues, schedules, workers and asynchronous processing.

surfaces.label: Integrations and external I/O
surfaces.description: First- or third-party integrations, external services, webhooks and outbound/inbound I/O.

surfaces.label: File storage and uploads
surfaces.description: Files, blobs, uploads, generated assets and storage lifecycle/security.

surfaces.label: Security and privacy
surfaces.description: Trust boundaries, data exposure, secrets, privacy constraints and material security behaviour.

surfaces.label: Performance and scale
surfaces.description: Latency, throughput, capacity, concurrency, quotas and scaling constraints.

surfaces.label: Runtime and deployment
surfaces.description: Runtime environments, hosting, deployment, configuration and release behaviour.

surfaces.label: Observability
surfaces.description: Logging, diagnostics, metrics, tracing, health/version and operational visibility.

surfaces.label: Recovery and rollback
surfaces.description: Failure recovery, backup/restore, retry behaviour and rollback guarantees.

surfaces.label: Compatibility
surfaces.description: Supported clients, browsers, devices, OS/runtime/database/API versions and compatibility constraints.

surfaces.label: Migration and backward compatibility
surfaces.description: Data/API/product migration, compatibility windows and transition strategy.

surfaces.label: Distribution and packaging
surfaces.description: Build artifacts, packaging, stores/registries, installation and distribution channels.

surfaces.label: Device and platform behaviour
surfaces.description: Platform-specific device/OS capabilities, permissions and lifecycle behaviour.

surfaces.label: Offline and synchronization
surfaces.description: Offline operation, caching, synchronization, conflict resolution and reconnect behaviour.
